preconditions.description: The length of the input string must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in palindrome)
preconditions.description: The input string must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: If the input string has a length of 1, the output must be an empty string.
The output string must be different from the input string and have the same length.
The output string must be lexicographically smaller than the input string.
